seo.title: National e-Licensing Platform: Case Study
seo.description: How Spectrum built a single online portal for licences and permits in Bangladesh: online applications and payment, automatic routing, e-signatures and QR-verified licences.

hero.title: National *e-Licensing* platform
hero.lead: How Spectrum replaced paper forms and long waits with one online portal where businesses apply for licences and permits, pay the fee and receive a licence anyone can verify.

sections.title: At a glance
body: Getting a trade licence or an import-export permit used to mean paper forms, office visits and weeks of waiting. Spectrum built one online portal where businesses apply, pay and receive their licence.

items.label: What we built
items.value: A single-window portal for licences and permits

sections.title: The problem
body: Applications were made on paper and checked in person. Each one passed from desk to desk, and it could take weeks to get a decision.
Applicants could not see where their application was, and payments were hard to track.

sections.title: What we built
sections.intro: A single window for the whole licence process:

items.title: Online applications
items.text: with document uploads, so there is no need to visit an office.

items.title: Automatic routing
items.text: sends each application to the right officer, based on clear rules.

items.title: Digitally signed licences with a QR code
items.text: that anyone can scan to check.

items.title: Apply
items.text: The business fills in the form online and uploads its documents.

items.title: Review
items.text: The application goes to the right officer automatically, and its status is visible.

items.title: Pay
items.text: The fee is paid online through e-challan.

items.title: Receive and verify
items.text: The signed licence is issued with a QR code that anyone can check.

sections.title: Results
bullets: The time to get a licence fell from 21 days to under 48 hours.
More than 100,000 licences issued, each one checkable by QR code.
Fees collected directly through Bangladesh Bank's e-challan.

items.title: Single-window portal:
items.text: one place to apply, pay, follow progress and download the licence.

items.title: Rule-based routing:
items.text: sends each application to the right desk without manual sorting.

items.title: Digital signatures (PKI):
items.text: prove which office issued a licence and that it has not been changed.
